evidence: Legacy cached target pages can carry more than the 10-row Tbio/Tdark stratum budget
metric: 425 legacy targets cached; 10-row Tbio/Tdark budget; F-0011
observation: The first 425 targets were cached before the per-target detail path existed and are reused by UniProt, so some Tbio/Tdark targets carry more than the declared 10-row nested sample even though the normaliser trims new pages. The KB records the effective behaviour rather than repeating the manifest guarantee, and the next revision must either re-apply the stratum trim or amend the manifest.
subject: F-9
title: F-0011: legacy cached pages exceed the declared Tbio/Tdark row budget
